result:
Summary of fixes made across 8 files:

- `src/lib/mentions.ts`: `resolveMentions` now maps a handle to *all* members sharing it (was last-write-wins), and no longer excludes viewer-role members.
- `src/server/services/comment-service.ts`: mention resolution now pages through the *entire* membership instead of just the first 100 (newest) members; excludes the comment's own author from its mentions; the 15-minute edit window is now measured from `createdAt` instead of `updatedAt`; the per-org rate limit call now also scopes by `actor.userId`; `updateComment` now re-resolves and persists mentions and emits a `comment.updated` event carrying only the newly-mentioned ids.
- `src/lib/rate-limit.ts`: added an optional `scope` parameter to `consumeRateLimit` so a bucket can be keyed per-member without changing its configured capacity/refill.
- `src/types/event.ts`: added the `comment.updated` event type.
- `src/server/repositories/comment-repository.ts`: `listThread` now collects all transitive descendants (reply-to-reply, any depth) in posting order, and no longer drops archived comments, so deleted comments stay as placeholders and their replies keep their anchor; `updateComment` now also persists `mentionedUserIds`.
- `src/server/services/notification-service.ts`: the `comment.created` handler now also notifies the parent comment's author on a reply, and excludes mentioned recipients from the plain comment alert (mention takes precedence, one alert per person); added a `comment.updated` subscriber that alerts only newly-mentioned users.
- `src/server/services/search-service.ts`: added a `comment.updated` subscriber so edited comment text is reindexed and becomes searchable.
- `src/components/domain/comment/comment-thread.tsx`: stopped filtering out archived comments, so deleted comments render as their placeholder instead of disappearing along with their replies.
- `src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts`: rate limit call scoped per-member to match the service layer.

All 616 existing tests and `tsc --noEmit` pass.
